\section*{Abstract}
This synthetic study measures cell growth in two culture conditions. This is original test text and describes no real experiment.
\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
We compare a dimensionless cell population $N(t)$ and cite a synthetic baseline \cite{synthetic}.
\section{Methods}\label{sec:methods}
A logistic model is
\begin{equation}\label{eq:growth}
\frac{dN}{dt}=rN\left(1-\frac{N}{K}\right).
\end{equation}
Equation~\eqref{eq:growth} describes the model; Section~\ref{sec:methods} defines the experiment.
